errors.text_span: die von einem nicht angegebenen Startwert bis zu 60 % reicht
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the y-axis range goes up to 60%. The y-axis starts at the origin (presumably 0) and extends to an unspecified maximum value that is higher than the starting point of the line, which itself is much higher than 60%. The value 60% is the asymptotic value the line approaches, not the upper limit of the axis.
